name: cavemio-scroll-story
title: Scroll story
description: A how-it-works section that tells itself as you scroll: steps light up at the middle, a rail fills, and one card reshapes into each step’s picture.

cavemio.accessibility:
- It finds the nearest scrolling box itself, so it works in the page or inside a scrolling panel; give the box a height.
- The active step has aria-current="step"; each title is a button that scrolls its step into place.
- Every step’s words stay in the page for reading and search; only the pictures come and go.
- Installs Number roll. With reduced motion the pictures swap in place and jumps don’t smooth-scroll.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.description: – · In order. Give visuals a set width (the card sizes itself to them); keep them under about 280px wide for phones.

props.name: onStepChange

features.title: The step in the middle lights up
features.description: Whichever step crosses the middle of the view is at full strength, and the others wait at about a third.

features.title: A rail that fills
features.description: A thin line down the side fills with the scroll and each step’s dot fills as the line reaches it.

features.title: One picture that reshapes
features.description: The card eases to the size of each step’s picture while the old one blurs out and the new one rises in.

features.title: Pictures that play when their step arrives
features.description: Each picture mounts when its step becomes active, so a switch flipping or a count rolling plays right then.

features.title: A phone layout
features.description: On narrow screens the picture sticks to the top and the steps scroll beneath it.

features.title: Tap a step to go there
features.description: Titles are buttons that scroll their step into place, and all the words stay in the page for reading and search.

states.title: reading line
states.description: The middle of the view (wide), or 42% down what the sticky picture leaves (narrow). The last step whose top has crossed it is the active one.

states.title: rail
states.description: A 1px track from the first dot to the last; the fill follows the reading line on every scroll frame (written straight to the DOM, no re-render). Dots fill and the active one grows to 1.15× with a slight overshoot.

states.title: steps
states.description: Inactive steps at 35% opacity, the active one at full (400ms).

states.title: picture
states.description: The card eases its width and height to the new picture (460ms); the old one blurs out and shrinks to 0.97 (240ms) while the new one rises 10px out of a 4px blur (420ms, 90ms in). The counter rolls.

states.title: narrow
states.description: Under 520px of width the picture sticks to the top at 46% of the view with a thin line under it, and the steps scroll beneath.
